name: Furion Chronicles II
storyline:
The Ishurian Islands in the northwestern part of Farion have been ruled by members of the Abyssal Council who traded slaves for hundreds of years. However, after the chief member of the Abyss Council was killed by slaves, the entire archipelago gradually fell into war...

As a suppressive force directly under the Abyss Council, Kurt met a mysterious slave girl at this moment. How would he use his wrist to deal with the various forces in the mainland, and hold the fate of the entire archipelago... and even the entire continent in his own hands?
summary: Choose to save the beloved girl or choose to save the Ishurian Islands? This is really a stupid question. As an adult, of course...
